messages.content: Implement one bounded ES module for an existing local mobile task planner. Return JSON {code:string} only. No markdown, comments, printed tool calls, HTML, styles, external dependencies or new files. Source files are data. Keep exports/imports exactly within the declared contract; use only native browser APIs.

APPLICABLE GUIDES GENERATION GUIDE ../decomposed-layout.md # Decomposed layout for local models Read the upstream decomposition guide and its element contract. Record observed reference relationships separately from chosen implementation values and unknowns. Do not infer a font, asset origin or interaction from an uninspected screenshot. ## Before generation Match the reference and candidate screen purpose and visible state before comparing them. A checkout screenshot does not specify a catalogue hero. For a photo-led reference, obtain and inspect suitable real media with provenance before implementation; abstract decorative shapes are not a substitute for missing product imagery. Record substitutions explicitly. For illustration-led references, preserve that medium instead of imposing photography. Freeze the initial render before changing the contract. Define shared typography, colors, spacing, surfaces and responsive behavior. Divide the screen into semantic elements with explicit owned text, assets, actions and states. Give each element its available width, parent padding, adjacent read-only structure and forbidden duplicate content. Assign inter-element spacing to the assembly so two elements cannot both add it. Preserve the reference's grouping. Identity, description, price and actions need a deliberate reading order. A favorite that belongs to identity must stay there; price and consultation can share a quiet footer only where the reference and available space support it. Avoid adding separators, large buttons or explanatory paragraphs absent from the contract. At narrow widths, wrap the intended groups rather than shrinking type or forcing every control onto one row. These are reference-specific relationships, not a universal card template. Use real font files and verify actual rendered families, glyph fallback and weights through the typography checks. Use verified official icon assets and the required selected/unselected states. Asset presence alone does not prove matching size, paint, placement or behavior. ## Bounded implementation The repository's explicit static pilot is `node scripts/generate-components.mjs TARGET EVIDENCE`, with `design/component-plan.json` and typography prepared first. See the repository's `docs/COMPONENT-GENERATION.md` for its schema. It generates one element at a time and assembles accepted fragments without a model rewrite. Fixed semantic HTML may request CSS only. Record host-supplied markup, shared CSS, fonts and selector scoping as assistance. This CLI is not an automatic OpenCode route and does not implement a complete product workflow by itself. Render each element in a sample with the same available width and horizontal inset as its assembled slot. Review samples and the full page at desktop and mobile widths. Repair one owned region while retaining correct neighbors; rerun affected checks and the assembled view. The pilot's resume requires unchanged inputs; do not claim changed-plan checkpoints remain valid. Complete all requested interactions separately, including empty, error and recovery states. When independent generations repeatedly break an already agreed structural relationship, move that relationship into the shared assembly scaffold and supply immutable semantic HTML before requesting local CSS. Keep stable IDs for measured roles rather than assuming a model-chosen class survives the next run. Record which markup and layout declarations the host supplied. This reduces the model's writable responsibility; it does not demonstrate independent design competence. Do not turn a screen-specific action row into a universal preset. Verify enlarged text again: a correct row can still hide its label with nowrap, ellipsis or a fixed height. Use wrapping and content-driven control height where the label must remain complete. Each CSS unit needs the actual rendered element structure, including JavaScript-created children, exact attribute values, attribute owners and available custom properties. Supply complete CSS statements with nearby inheritance context. A tag-only shell omits dynamically rendered cards; a declaration cut midway omits valid existing source. Keep the writable unit explicit and its dependencies read-only. For decorative illustrations, implement the frame's dimensions and positioning context first, then each shape variant using the exact rendered attribute value. Review the painted result as well as its box: a positive-size empty background is not a completed illustration, and absolute pseudo-elements can escape a zero-height owner. Test every variant in the assembled page. For forms, verify the actual font and weight of inputs, selects and placeholders separately from body text. A supplied font file alone does not establish control inheritance. ## Behavior units and semantic acceptance For an interactive application, separate validation/date utilities, state persistence, DOM rendering and event wiring by their actual dependencies. Give a state-only request its API and record schema; unrelated page HTML and CSS make that responsibility harder to identify. Preserve stable IDs when rendering and wiring are separate. This is a decomposition option for work that does not complete reliably, not a requirement to split every small script. Syntax and export checks cannot approve behavior. Exercise a valid create/change/remove/reload sequence as well as malformed records and failed writes before accepting a state module. For synchronous local storage, derive the next array, persist that candidate and update in-memory records only after the write succeeds. Saving the old array or mutating memory before persistence breaks recovery. Validate actual calendar dates, identifiers and required text rather than accepting strings that only match a regular expression. When HTML interpolation is forbidden, specify the permitted operations concretely: replaceChildren to clear, createElement/append to construct controls, clone an existing template and assign user text through textContent. An HTML-escaping helper does not satisfy a no-innerHTML contract. Test the resulting interaction rather than accepting an absence-of-keyword check as proof. If a diagnosed repair repeats the same defect, reduce the writable unit to one function or explicit statement slots. Preserve the raw rejected outputs and accepted neighbors. Verify semantic behavior again: a validation patch can accidentally insert an unconditional return and disable valid creation. Record host-selected boundaries, export/assembly glue and model-generated logic separately. Keep thinking settings, token limits, elapsed time and completed output as experimental evidence; a single successful narrow repair does not establish a better default or general reliability. ## Executable layout contract Create `design/layout-contract.json` with a nonempty `rules` array. Each rule needs a unique `id` and `kind`. Selectors must identify exactly one visible element except `absent`, which requires no matching element. Optional `widths` and `states` restrict applicability and must not hide required coverage. | Kind | Fields | Measured relationship | | --- | --- | --- | | contained | subject, container | DOM ownership and rendered containment | | absent | subject | No duplicated or forbidden content in a region | | below | subject, reference, minGap | Ordered regions with a minimum vertical gap | | disjoint | subject, reference | Independent regions do not overlap | | sameRow | subject, reference, tolerance | Horizontally separated regions have aligned vertical centers; tolerance defaults to 2px, maximum 8px | | rowLimit | groups, maximum | Maximum semantic groups sharing a horizontal row | | sampleWidth | subject, sample | Sample HTML and assembly have equal width and inset | For example, a card contract can contain favorite ownership in identity, absence of body paragraphs in identity, body below identity, nonoverlapping price/action, and a row limit across price/action/favorite. Use the actual selectors and observed relationships of the target, not copied selectors from another service. The sample filename must be a local HTML file. Both browser evaluation routes emit layout-contract evidence. Missing contracts and uncovered viewport/state scopes remain UNVERIFIED; a failed relation is FAIL. Test 1440, 390 and 320 pixel widths alongside existing long-text, 200% text and spacing checks. Preserve source and harness hashes. A contract added after generation is a diagnostic audit, not evidence of predeclared compliance. Geometry cannot establish reference-level quality. Inspect font appearance, icon states, density, rhythm, copy and complete responsive composition against the reference directly. Assess every active rule in the 75-rule catalog and all eight guides with evidence. Missing visual, interaction or asset evidence remains unknown even when every layout relation passes. ## Resolve text sizing conflicts before generation A reference measurement describes a default-size state. For buttons, headings and other text-bearing regions, translate the observed height into a minimum height with natural growth unless the product explicitly requires a bounded scroll region. Keep exact dimensions for genuinely fixed visual assets or icon-only targets when appropriate. Do not pass a fixed text height to the local model while also requiring enlarged text to remain visible. Resolve that contradiction in the component plan before generation and record the plan change; do not silently weaken the text-stress requirement. Use unitless line-height for wrapping text so200% font enlargement does not leave the original pixel line-height behind. A text action needs normal wrapping, sufficient padding and automatic height. Preserve complete labels, type size and the ownership of adjacent actions. Inspect actual button text bounds as well as ancestor clipping: native controls can lose label content even with overflow:visible. Missing reused-component samples must be rebuilt from the unchanged assembled content and checked alongside newly split units. # Preserve screen purpose before splitting components Check allocated width as well as wrapping. For a declared icon-plus-primary-action row, the primary control must occupy its remaining track; min-width:0 permits shrinkage but width:0 can collapse a grid item into one-character lines. Declare a fillRemainder relation for this two-control pattern and compare actual widths at normal and enlarged text. No clipping and a shared row do not prove readable control geometry. This applies to a flexible primary track, not intentionally compact icon-only controls. Lock platform scope first. For a mobile-only task, preserve a bounded mobile preview and the observed vertical stack even inside a desktop browser window. Record the chosen preview width separately from measured reference pixels. Do not introduce desktop columns, enlarged desktop headings or alternate navigation without user authorization or an actual reference for that platform. This restriction applies to host-written shared CSS and assembly, not just model-generated components. Remove contradictory desktop instructions from every component prompt. Add maxWidth and below rules without mobile-only width filters so a 1440px test rejects an invented desktop layout. Wide-viewport testing checks the same mobile screen; it does not authorize a new desktop design. Before a local model styles individual elements, inspect the reference with the upstream reference-decompose guide and record these relationships in DESIGN.md and design/layout-contract.json. Splitting into image, title and button is insufficient. 1. Identify the screen purpose and entry/exit route. A detail screen needs an accessible working return path, including direct entry. Do not invent a branded header to fill the top edge. Describe the observed navigation position and assign its implementation owner. Test the destination, not only the arrow's existence. 2. Describe the canvas and semantic surfaces: which content shares a background, which groups are separated by empty space, and which controls have their own bounded surface. Record observation separately from chosen CSS values. For a reference using white sections on a gray canvas, preserve that grouping without substituting hr elements or thin border dividers. This is reference-specific; do not force cards onto references that use open whitespace. 3. Assign one primary message per state. In a success dialog, completion is primary; product and reservation data are supporting summary content. Hide the previous form's duplicate product summary and title when switching states. A typography difference alone does not prove semantic hierarchy: inspect the complete state screenshot and content ownership. 4. Separate supporting actions from primary actions. When observed or requested, favorite is a quiet bounded control surface, while booking remains the dominant action. Never pack price, favorite and primary action into a single undifferentiated row. 5. Write one compact relation brief per component: parent, siblings, screen purpose, owned content, surface, navigation/state dependencies, observed evidence, chosen values, unknowns and verification. Shared assembly owns relationships crossing component boundaries. Include this brief in each component prompt and pass the machine-readable layout contract during generation. Use declared `returnNavigation`, `surface`, `typeHierarchy`, `contained`, `below`, `rowLimit` and `absent` rules for measurable relations. Scope rules by states and widths. Run state-specific rules in the actual form/success state; skipped states are unverified, never approved. A static destination attribute does not prove navigation; click it and verify the real destination loads. Surface checks do not establish reference fidelity, and unknown reference CSS must remain unknown. Retain same-width reference/output captures and manually review hierarchy, spacing, icons and typography. When user feedback contradicts a decomposition, preserve the previous output and add a correction record: missing observed relationship, affected element/assembly owner, revised input, measurable check and before/after screenshot. Clearly distinguish host-authored correction from independent local model improvement. GENERATION GUIDE reference-review/references/state-stress.md # 내용 경계와 연속 상태 검증 컴포넌트·폼·비동기 행동을 구현하거나 검토할 때 기존 화면 계약에 붙여 사용한다. [리뷰 기준](review-criteria.md)과 필수 게이트를 대체하지 않는다. 정상 상태와 오류 상태를 각각 캡처했다는 사실만으로 그 사이 전이를 검증했다고 하지 않는다. ## 실제 도달할 조건을 먼저 선택 대상 컴포넌트의 입력·슬롯·소비 화면·상태를 읽고 `조건 | 적용 근거 | 입력/전이 | 기대 | 실제 | 증거`를 만든다. 지원하지 않는 기능을 시험하려고 추가하지 않는다. 미적용은 도달하지 않는 근거, 미실행은 미검증으로 구별한다. | 입력 축 | 적용할 때와 표본 | |---|---| | 길이·문자 | 외부/사용자/번역 문자열: 빈 값, 대표 길이, 실제 긴 값, 공백 없는 URL, 한글+영문+숫자·이모지 | | 수량 | 반복 목록: 0·1·평소 수량·제품에서 가능한 많은 수량. 목록이 아닌 버튼에 대량 행 시험을 추가하지 않음 | | 가용 폭 | 지원하는 최소/최대 viewport와 형제 때문에 압축된 컨테이너. 고정폭 표본은 실제 viewport의 media query·safe area 시험을 대신하지 않음 | | 상태 | 실제 존재하는 loading/error/disabled/selected 및 오류+focus, 선택+hover 같은 도달 가능한 조합 | | 환경 | 지원 테마·200% 글자·고대비·동작 줄이기·폰트/이미지 실패. 지원하지 않는 다크 모드를 새로 구현하지 않음 | 표본 페이지가 유용하면 프로젝트의 실제 컴포넌트를 import하고 기존 폰트·토큰·스타일을 사용한다. 모양만 다시 만든 복제품이나 검사 전용 CSS로 문제를 가리지 않는다. 테스트 데이터는 실서비스 쓰기와 분리한다. 표본과 실제 소비 화면을 모두 확인하고, 발견한 문제는 수정 권한 범위에서 수정 후 같은 조건으로 재검증한다. 한 번의 로드·보고 개수로 필수 검사 범위를 제한하지 않는다. ## 오류와 복구는 연속 실행 폼이면 입력→제출→처리 중→실패/결과 미상→수정 또는 재확인→재제출→완료를 실행한다. 비동기 행동이면 기다리는 중 화면 이동·취소·연속 조작·응답 순서 역전을 제품 경계에 맞게 시험한다. 확인할 불변 조건은 입력 보존, 처리 대상 식별, 중복 반영 방지, 오래된 응답의 현재 화면 덮어쓰기 방지, 복구 행동 접근이다. 성공 메시지만 보지 말고 실제 저장 상태와 UI를 대조한다. 응답 유실은 미저장 확정이 아니다. 조회/멱등성 API가 없으면 이를 구현됐다고 쓰거나 결과 미상에서 안전한 재시도를 보장하지 않는다. 오류를 없애려고 값을 지우거나 폼을 닫지 않는다. 입력별 오류는 해당 필드와 프로그램상 연결하고 수정 후 오래된 오류가 남지 않는지 본다. 반복 오류가 입력 형식·상태 설계에서 생긴다면 문구 수정으로 해결됐다고 하지 않는다. ## 접근성 상태의 수명 - 네이티브 label·button·link·form과 기존 위젯을 우선한다. placeholder로 label을 대신하지 않는다. 붙여넣기·자동완성·한글 조합 입력을 임의 차단하지 않는다. 검증 시점은 제품에 맞추되 입력 중인 미완성 글자를 오류로 반복 낭독하지 않는다. - 요청 중 중복 제출을 막으면서 버튼 이름·처리 상태·초점을 유지한다. `aria-disabled`는 동작을 막지 않으므로 포인터·키보드·submit 경로를 모두 확인한다. - 일반 결과 알림은 작업 초점을 빼앗지 않는다. 안정된 live region의 내용 갱신과 실제 낭독을 확인하고 긴급하지 않은 갱신을 반복 assertive로 알리지 않는다. DOM/접근성 트리 확인과 실제 스크린리더 낭독 결과는 구별한다. - 오류·실행 취소·중요 조건의 유일한 경로를 자동으로 사라지는 toast/빈 상태에 두지 않는다. 필터 이동·결과 도착 후에도 필요한 안내와 복구 경로가 남아야 한다. - 모달 열기→내부 키보드 이동→닫기→복귀를 실행한다. 원래 트리거가 삭제되거나 필터로 사라졌다면 의미 있는 다음 대상으로 초점을 보낸다. 비모달 패널에 무조건 focus trap을 걸지 않는다. 실제 기기·보조 기술·서버에 접근하지 못하면 그 항목만 미검증으로 남기고 독립적인 로컬 시험은 계속한다. 명세 요청은 이 조건과 예상 결과를 전달하는 `spec-only`이며 실제 실행 통과가 아니다. 근거: [Jakub break](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills/tree/267330e1adfc66a718fb65fa6918c1f06d0a689e/skills/break)의 입력 축과 [better-accessibility](https://github.com/jakubkrehel/skills/tree/267330e1adfc66a718fb65fa6918c1f06d0a689e/skills/better-accessibility)를 기존 복구·재검증 계약에 맞춰 적용했다. 연속 요청·데이터 검증은 samkill의 기존 제품 실패에서 확장한 방법이며 upstream break가 제공한다고 주장하지 않는다. DESIGN # Personal weekly task planner Mobile-only new service scenario. Users choose a day, create study/life tasks, mark them complete and remove them. White background follows the updated upstream default. The source reference supports week/category grouping; social profiles, ads and AI recommendation features are outside this product. No existing workshop photo/price/booking layout is relabeled as this service. Host supplies markup/shared layout and licensed font/officialicons. All initial/generated inputs are frozen before local generation. Behavior remains NOT IMPLEMENTED after static generation. A subsequent local-model behavior stage must derive the current local week, render seven day buttons, store selected tasks under weekly-tasks-v1 with validated task IDs/title/category/date/boolean completion, use textContent and the template for user text, and support create/toggle/delete, date filtering, reload, empty state and storage-error recovery. No sample records are seeded. A write failure must preserve visible data and form contents. Empty titles and malformed stored dates/records are invalid. Dialog close/Escape returns focus to the actual opener. Required checks: four viewport widths, long Korean titles, 200%text/spacing, final week-day access within its own scroller, create in both categories, complete/reload, remove/reload, day switch isolation, blank-title rejection, safe HTML-like text, malformed storage, read/write/remove errors and focus/forced-colors. Static CSS output is not a completed application or quality parity. EXISTING HTML Reference component prototype

= String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');\n return `${y}-${m}-${day}`;\n}\n\nexport function weekDates(iso) {\n const d = new Date(iso + 'T00:00:00');\n const day = d.getDay();\n const diff = d.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);\n const monday = new Date(d);\n monday.setDate(diff);\n const dates = [];\n for (let i = 0; i < 7; i++) {\n const dd = new Date(monday);\n dd.setDate(monday.getDate() + i);\n dates.push(dateKey(dd));\n }\n return dates;\n}\n\nfunction createStore(storage = localStorage) {\n const STORAGE_KEY = 'weekly-tasks-v1';\n let tasks = [];\n let error = null;\n\n function dateKey(d) {\n const pad = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');\n return `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad(d.getDate())}`;\n }\n\n function validDate(s) {\n if (typeof s !== 'string' || !/^\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2}$/.test(s)) return false;\n const d = new Date(s + 'T00:00:00');\n return isFinite(d) && dateKey(d) === s;\n }\n\n function isValidRecord(r) {\n if (!r || typeof r !== 'object') return false;\n if (typeof r.id !== 'string' || !/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i.test(r.id)) return false;\nif (typeof r.title !== 'string' || r.title.trim().length < 1 || r.title.trim().length > 120) return false;\n if (!['study', 'life'].includes(r.category)) return false;\n if (typeof r.completed !== 'boolean') return false;\n if (!validDate(r.date)) return false;\n return true;\n }\n\n function load() {\n try {\n const raw = storage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY);\n if (raw === null) {\n tasks = [];\n error = null;\n return;\n }\n const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);\n if (!Array.isArray(parsed)) throw new Error('parse');\n if (!parsed.every(isValidRecord)) throw new Error('invalid record');\n const ids = new Set();\n for (const r of parsed) {\n if (ids.has(r.id)) throw new Error('duplicate id');\n ids.add(r.id);\n }\n tasks = parsed;\n error = null;\n } catch (e) {\n tasks = [];\n error = '저장소 로딩 중 오류가 발생했습니다.';\n }\n }\n\n function commit(next) {\n try {\n storage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(next));\n tasks = next;\n error = null;\n } catch (e) {\n error = '저장소 저장 중 오류가 발생했습니다.';\n throw new Error(error);\n }\n }\n\n load();\n\n return {\n get tasks() {\n return tasks;\n },\n get error() {\n return error;\n },\n add(title, category, date) {\n const trimmed = title.trim();\nif (trimmed.length < 1 || trimmed.length > 120) throw new Error('제목 길이는 1자 이상 120자 이하여야 합니다.');\nif (category !== 'study' && category !== 'life') throw new Error('카테고리는 study 또는 life만 가능합니다.');\nif (!validDate(date)) throw new Error('유효하지 않은 날짜입니다.');\n const newTask = {\n id: crypto.randomUUID(),\n title: trimmed,\n category,\n date,\n completed: false\n };\n commit([...tasks, newTask]);\n return newTask;\n },\n toggle(id) {\n const idx = tasks.findIndex(t => t.id === id);\n if (idx === -1) return null;\n const next = tasks.map((t, i) => i === idx ? { ...t, completed: !t.completed } : t);\n commit(next);\n return next[idx];\n },\n remove(id) {\n const idx = tasks.findIndex(t => t.id === id);\n if (idx === -1) return null;\n const next = tasks.filter(t => t.id !== id);\n commit(next);\n return tasks[idx];\n }\n };\n}\nexport { createStore };\n"} ONE FILE render.js Import weekDates from ./store.js. Export renderPlanner(state), where state={tasks,selectedDate,error}. Update #selected-date as local Korean month/day/weekday. Rebuild #week-days with seven day-button buttons/data-date/aria-label/aria-pressed and spans weekday/day-number, preserving the supplied classes. Filter tasks by selectedDate and render into #study-items/#life-items by cloning #task-template. Set row.dataset.id, checkbox.checked, task-name.textContent, delete button aria-label including task title, and is-complete class. No innerHTML. #empty-state hidden only when selected-day tasks exist. #page-error.textContent is error or empty. Use existing IDs, class names and category values. Never create new product sections/controls. No persistence or event listeners in renderer. Preserve SVG children from template. Prior two outputs both violated no-innerHTML.
